scenes.name: Neon split
scenes.description: Two hard coloured lights from either side of frame meet down the middle of the face, with a faint fill so the dark side does not go black. Four palettes: blue and red, orange and teal, magenta and cyan, violet and amber.
scenes.bestIn: Dark interior or night, close portrait.

scenes.name: Neon wall, hard
scenes.description: A hard magenta spot hits one side of the face from the left while the rest of the frame and the wall behind sit in deep blue. The face goes half pink, half blue.
scenes.bestIn: Anywhere, since the backdrop supplies the blue. Best with the camera at chest height.

set.notes: A dyed sweep once the Set tab lands; the partition panel until then.

scenes.name: Neon wall, soft
scenes.description: A wide, soft pink key from the front left, a cooler lavender fill and a lavender wall. Shadows turn violet rather than black. A second palette puts an orange key against a bright cyan wall.
scenes.bestIn: Close portraits. Works in daylight and indoors.

set.notes: A dyed sweep once the Set tab lands; the partition panel until then.

scenes.name: Rim only
scenes.description: Two lights from behind and above trace the hair and shoulder, and a dim light from the front side keeps the profile readable. Turn side-on. Palettes: green neon, white, amber.

scenes.name: Hair glow
scenes.description: Two bright white-cool lights behind and above light up the edges of the hair, and a wide soft light from the front keeps the face gentle.
scenes.bestIn: Dark or dim scenes. Looks best head-on or three-quarter.

scenes.name: Split light
scenes.description: One narrow spot from the side and above with a sharp edge, so half the face goes dark. No fill at all.
scenes.bestIn: Dark scenes. Face the camera, turn the head slightly to the light.

scenes.name: Window light
scenes.description: A broad soft source from one side, like a window, with a weak warm bounce from the other. The shadow side is gentle and the skin stays even.
scenes.bestIn: Indoors or anywhere. Turn towards the window side.

scenes.name: Golden hour
scenes.description: A low warm sun from the front side, a hot amber rim from behind and above, and a weak sky-blue fill in the shade.
scenes.bestIn: Outdoors or any scene with plenty of open space.

scenes.name: High key
scenes.description: A bright white backdrop, a large soft key and a soft fill. A faint blue edge light from low on one side adds a cool tint to the skin.
scenes.bestIn: Anywhere. The white backdrop gives a seamless studio look.

set.notes: A seamless white sweep once the Set tab lands; the white partition until then.

scenes.name: Rembrandt
scenes.description: A key about 45 degrees to one side and about 45 degrees above eye line, with a small fill on the other side and no backdrop light. The check is a small triangle of light on the cheek in shadow.
scenes.bestIn: Dark or dim scenes. Turn the head a little away from the key.

scenes.name: Butterfly
scenes.description: One key straight in front and high, about 2.5 m up, which drops a small shadow under the nose. A low flat fill below the chin lifts the shadow under the jaw.
scenes.bestIn: Anywhere. Face the camera and keep the chin level.

scenes.name: Loop
scenes.description: A key about 30 degrees to the side and a little above, with a soft fill. The nose throws a small loop of shadow on the cheek.
scenes.bestIn: Anywhere. A safe, flattering portrait light.

scenes.name: Clamshell
scenes.description: A key high in front and a fill low in front at about half the strength, so the face is lit from above and below like the two halves of a shell. The beauty rig.

scenes.name: Silhouette
scenes.description: A bright wash on the wall behind and a rim from behind, with nothing on the front, so the subject reads as a dark shape against the glow.
scenes.bestIn: Anywhere with room behind the subject. Stand side-on.

set.notes: A bright sweep once the Set tab lands.

scenes.name: Low key
scenes.description: One narrow key from the side, no fill and no backdrop light. Most of the frame stays dark.
scenes.bestIn: Dark scenes. Turn a little towards the light.

scenes.name: Club strobe
scenes.description: Magenta and cyan washes from either side and a hard white strobe from the front. The strobe is OFF until you switch it on in the Lighting tab, and it never flashes faster than 3 times a second. Flashing light can affect people with photosensitive epilepsy.
scenes.bestIn: Dark interior, any framing. Turn the strobe on for one shot, then off again.

scenes.name: Campfire flicker
scenes.description: A low orange light in front, where a fire would be, with a faint blue moon from behind. The fire flickers and drifts. Switch the flicker off in the Lighting tab for a still frame.
scenes.bestIn: Outdoors at night, sitting or crouching.

camera.notes: Chest-up, a little below eye level.

scenes.name: Neon sign flicker
scenes.description: A pink sign that stutters, lighting one side of the face and washing the wall behind. The sign and its wall flicker together, as a failing tube does.

set.notes: A dark sweep once the Set tab lands; the partition panel until then.
